messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo: token velocity & dedicated fit — pricing bands and next steps

Hi Emma / Sam —

Great speaking earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can put together a concrete reserved-capacity proposal for CipherHealth's pilot: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Target pilot window: 8–12 weeks, phased rollout to 3 product teams.
- Expected traffic pattern: bursty mornings (8–11am PT) + steady tail; estimated peak QPS/throughput targets discussed below.
- Primary workload: chat summarization + patient triage pre-populated prompts (avg context ~1.2k tokens).

Confirmed ask: CipherHealth is looking for a dedicated/reserved lane conversation — predictable latency and data isolation are requirements. Pricing sensitivity: finance gave a monthly budget range (see below) and want unit economics around $/1M tokens.

Open data points we still need from you to finalize an anchor price: 
1) Monthly committed tokens (low/expected/high) — you mentioned 800M as a mid case; can you confirm low = 300M and high = 1.4B?
2) Target SLO for 95th perc latency during peak windows (in ms).
3) Any regulatory/regional constraints for VPC/on-prem for the pilot.

Our preliminary numbers (high-level) for a 1.0B monthly committed token footprint:
- Suggested GPU family: H100-preferred for latency headroom, A100 option if your cost target is binding.
- Reserved lane sizing: 4 H100 GPUs (dedicated pool) to hit ~300–500 tokens/sec sustained throughput with burst headroom; A100 equivalent is approx 6 GPUs for same throughput.
- Target unit economics (ballpark): $10–$18 per 1M tokens depending on GPU family and burst allowance (H100 on the higher end but better latency).
- Example monthly anchor: 1.0B tokens -> $10k–$18k * (1.0B / 1M) = $10k–$18k? (Note: numbers below will be refined after Karthik confirms hardware margins)

Next steps I propose: 
- Emma: confirm the low/mid/high monthly committed tokens and the desired 95th perc latency SLO by Mon, Jun 1.
- Karthik / Laura: I’ll ask you to build a 2-option grid (H100 vs A100-based lanes) with price per 1M token and expected throughput per GPU. Please attach to the follow-up.
- I will draft a two-tier proposal (Pilot: 3-month commit + optional rollout to prod) once we get the token numbers.

Attachments: placeholder for our internal pricing sheet (will send with Karthik's grid).

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Thanks Sofia — nice recap. Quick answers inline: 

1) Monthly committed tokens (low / mid / high): 300M / 900M / 1.6B (the 800M I said on the call was a rough memory; finance prefers 900M mid).
2) 95th perc latency SLO: 400ms for user-facing chat. We can tolerate up to 600ms for async batch jobs.
3) No on-prem for pilot; we will need VPC connectivity only.

Budget guidance from finance: we have a monthly budget envelope that tops out at $45k for the pilot phase but they prefer it to be closer to $20k/mo. If we can see $/1M tokens under $12 that would be compelling. 

Also — one nuance: our peak bursts are tighter than I described; mornings spike to ~1.2k concurrent chats, not just QPS. That might materially affect lane sizing.

Happy to have Sam and I review the pricing grid when you send it.

—Emma

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: token velocity & dedicated fit — pricing bands and next steps

Adding the hardware/math context and attaching a quick grid.

Attachment: cipher_dedicated_pricing_grid.xlsx (stub)
Also attached: cipher_token_velocity_matrix.csv (traffic profile we inferred)

Notes from infra sizing: 
- Workload characterization: avg seq len ~1.2k tokens, generation avg 150 tokens/session. Effective tokens per call ~1350.
- Concurrency peak: 1.2k concurrent chats -> endogenous concurrency pressure on KV cache and batching efficiency.

H100 lane (recommended):
- 1 H100 sustained (optimistic) throughput: ~120–140 tokens/sec for this model/profile.
- For peak window sizing target ~500 tokens/sec sustained (to cover 95th and headroom): need ~4 H100s dedicated (4 * 125 = 500).
- Cost drivers: H100 reserved unit cost + caching overhead + network egress.

A100 lane (cost-sensitive):
- 1 A100 sustained throughput: ~80–95 tokens/sec.
- Equivalent lane to H100 4x -> need 6 A100s to hit similar throughput.
- Lower unit cost per GPU but higher fleet size; tends to push $/1M tokens down ~10–20% in long tail but increases latency risk during spikes.

Pricing band (pre-margin, platform fee included):
- H100 proposal: $13–$17 per 1M tokens (range depends on commit term + burst allowance).
- A100 proposal: $10–$14 per 1M tokens.

Given CipherHealth's stated preference for <$12/1M, A100 option can hit that band at 900M committed with a 3-month pilot and tighter burst caps (we would include a negotiated burst rollover).

I’ll draft a short two-option table for Sofia to include in the proposal:
Option A (latency-focused): 4x H100 lane, target 500 tokens/sec sustained for peak windows, unit econ $15/1M.
Option B (cost-focused): 6x A100 lane, target equivalent throughput, unit econ $11/1M if commit >=900M/mo.

Karthik
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks for the fast clarifications and the budget signal. 

Short summary + proposed next steps: 
- You confirmed: 300M / 900M / 1.6B monthly tokens. Peak concurrency ~1.2k chats in mornings. 95th SLO 400ms. VPC only for pilot.
- Practical recommendation: send both options to finance — we’ll anchor with Option B (cost-focused A100) at $11/1M for 900M commit to meet your <$12 target, and include Option A (H100) at $15/1M as the low-latency alternative. Both proposals include a burst allowance (30% over committed) with defined overage rates.

Proposed concrete milestones: 
1) Today: I’ll upload the two-option pricing sheet and a short SOW draft to the HubSpot deal record.
2) Tue, Jun 2: Finance review — Emma to confirm if they can agree to 900M commit for pilot or need to stay at 300M. 
3) Wed, Jun 3: If finance okays commit, Karthik will produce a simple billing schedule and we’ll issue a PLA + DocuSign link for signature.

Action items for CipherHealth: please reply to confirm whether finance will sign for the 900M mid-case commitment or prefer to pilot at 300M. If 300M, we’ll re-run the unit-econ and likely only offer H100 at smaller lane sizes (higher $/1M).

I’ll push the attachments to the deal (links above) and will ping this thread when the DocuSign is ready.

Thanks —
